snippet.title: Operation: Outbreak - Official Trailer | A Free-to-Play Zombie FPS Horror Game
snippet.description:
Play Operation: Outbreak on Steam FOR FREE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4169300/Operation_Outbreak

Your squad's vehicle exploded during a patrol, and you're the only survivor. The enemy is unusual this time. A virus has turned the city into a warzone of the undead. Get to the exfil in time or die trying. A free-to-play short and intense FPS zombie survival horror game.
